messages:
ana_head_of_marketing: Quick kickoff: we need a compact, embeddable pricing micro-calculator for the EU launch. Objectives: reduce pre-sales questions, boost trial starts, and capture a few intent events for follow-up. Can we align on tier names, core FAQs, and rollout plan?

jane_marketing: I'm free at 2pm CET. I'll bring conversion benchmarks and a short webinar teaser to tie into the launch.

sam_growth: Recent tests: inline calculators + contextual FAQ outperform static pricing by ~10% on trial starts. Keep it lightweight.

eli_product: Proposed tier names for parity with product docs: "Developer", "Team", "Scale". Avoid "Production" (translation noise).

sofia_localization: +1 on Developer/Team/Scale. I'll flag ambiguous words for FR/DE/ES and recommend short tooltips. Also watch pluralization in languages with complex grammar.

luke_design: I'll produce two variants: compact card (320w) and modal (centered). Need max CTAs: primary 28 chars, helper line 80 chars. Colors to match pricing page.

max_frontend: I can wire the embeddable JS widget. Need an estimate endpoint and a canned response shape to build against. Prefer JSON v1.

eli_product: Use: GET /api/v1/marketing/pricing/estimate?region=eu&monthly=true. Sample: ```{ "tier": "Team", "cost": 95, "included_tokens": 150000, "notes": "overage billed per 1k tokens" }```

noah_analytics: Metric tracking: event names - pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_calc_selection, pricing_calc_cta_click. We'll instrument funnel and attribute to experiment.

sam_growth: A/B test setup: control = current pricing page; variant = pricing page + embedded microcalc above the fold. Primary metric = trial start rate; guardrail = bounce. Minimum detectable lift 1.5% with 95% power.

ana_head_of_marketing: Owners: copy = @jane_marketing, UX = @luke_design, frontend = @max_frontend, analytics = @noah_analytics, localization = @sofia_localization. Ship to staging by Thu EOD.

jane_marketing: Draft FAQs I'm planning to include: 1) How are charges calculated? 2) What happens if I go over usage? 3) Which models can I use on each tier? 4) How is my data handled? 5) Do you offer trial credits or refunds? Will drop copy in thread.

sofia_localization: For FAQ 3, we'll need model family names localized carefully. Suggest keeping proper nouns (e.g., Mistral, Llama) untranslated and clarifying in parentheses.

luke_design: Copy for the CTA variants: primary = "Estimate my monthly cost" (23 chars), alt = "See options" (11 chars). Using the 23-char CTA for mobile.

max_frontend: I'll prototype with canned responses tonight. Can someone add the sample JSON to the docs?

eli_product: Pasted example in API doc stub and added note: "pricing estimates are indicative; enterprise quotes via sales."

deploybot: deploybot: branch created pricing/microcalc-eu (CI queued) :rocket:

noah_analytics: I'll add the tracking hooks and create the experiment in Optimizely. Expect initial data in ~48h after staging push.

jane_marketing: Webinar blurb to cross-post in 1 week: "Live demo: Using our new pricing estimator to plan LLM costs — tips for teams scaling inference." Short registration funnel -> email follow-up. Will post copy later today.

ana_head_of_marketing: Great. If A/B meets >=1.5% CR lift we flip and run webinar the following week. Call out any dependencies by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone!

max_frontend: Noted. Will ping if API needs change.

sofia_localization: Will deliver translation notes and suggested tooltips by tomorrow morning.

sam_growth: Adding: include a micro-survey post-CTA for users who don't convert (1 question) to capture friction. Low lift on UI but high signal.

ana_head_of_marketing: Love that. Put it in the experiment spec. Closing the loop after staging run.
